name: Jarvis Assistant Vocal
tagline: Local French voice assistant with Claude/Ollama and home integrations
description: Jarvis Assistant Vocal is a voice assistant built around Claude and Ollama that runs fully offline. It is a French-language ecosystem project that integrates with Philips Hue lights, OBS, Google Calendar, Gmail, and Twilio, letting you control your smart home and workflow by voice. For privacy-minded users who want an assistant that does not depend on a cloud vendor, it is a practical, self-contained alternative.
highlights: Local voice assistant running on Claude and Ollama
Fully offline, no cloud vendor dependency
Integrates Philips Hue, OBS, Google Calendar, Gmail, and Twilio
curatorNote: A privacy-preserving, fully offline voice assistant that ties into the smart home is exactly the direction local AI should go. The French-language ecosystem angle only adds to its distinctiveness.
